'''Mann Do'Kor'chok''' was a [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]] for [[Cobalt Conglomerate]]. Do'Kor'chok was on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation]] to win a [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] contract for Cobalt Conglomerate.<ref name="Game" />
